summary: The parent indexes POWI_EXPONENTS by radix instead of radix minus two, selecting incorrect exponent chunks and accessing outside the array for radices 35 and 36. The fix subtracts two through base_to_powi!. A valid same-path verbatim reversal is blocked: the buggy implementation resides in deleted src/atof/basen.rs, while the corrected implementation resides in newly added src/atof/algorithm/lossy.rs, which has no parent-revision region. No detecting upstream test was found: the commit adds no assertions, decimal tests use an unaffected table entry, and base-36 tests parse only integers without invoking POWI. No builds or tests were run.
